class.name: PhysXCaveMist3D
class.brief_description: Cold mist breathed out of sea-cave mouths by the swell, in NVIDIA Flow.
class.description: Each swell that runs into a sea cave compresses the air inside and pushes it back out through the mouth. That air carries spray, is saturated, and is cooler than the air outside, so it comes out as a pale, heavy breath that sinks over the water and thins as the drops evaporate. This node puts one emitter just inside each sea-cave mouth of a [CaveNetwork3D] within [member near_range] of the target. The emitters pulse with the swell: mist goes out on each surge, and a little air is drawn back in between. The mist lives in a [PhysXFlow3D] of the node's own. The [CaveNetwork3D] makes this node itself when it has sea caves (its [code]sea_mist[/code] property).
